key_concepts: Circuit diagrams use symbols to represent electrical components
A switch opens and closes a circuit
A source provides energy for electrons to flow
A single cell is a source of electrical energy
A battery is a combination of cells
Wires connect components in a circuit
A bulb consumes electricity and converts it to another form of energy
Adding more batteries can make a bulb brighter
Adding more bulbs can make each bulb dimmer
A circuit needs an energy source for a bulb to light
Changing the number or type of components affects how a circuit works
